sheet.summary: Jio Platforms concluded India's largest initial public offering to raise Rs 30,213 crore, with grey market indicators positioning the firm to become the country's second-largest listed corporation by market value. Salaried Indian households should follow this event closely because retail bidders had Rs 13,428 per lot blocked during allotment, while mutual funds held in monthly household SIPs will likely rebalance weightings toward the new mega-cap stock. Furthermore, industry analysts project mobile tariff price hikes of 12% to 15% following the listing, which will directly impact monthly household phone and broadband bills.
